name: Apprenticeship Wage Subsidy (AWS)
provider: Government of Newfoundland and Labrador, Department of Education and Early Childhood Development, Apprenticeship and Trades Certification Division

summary.quote: The Apprenticeship Wage Subsidy (AWS) program assists apprentices in gaining work experience in a skilled trade, and progress to journeyperson certification by providing a wage subsidy to employers.

sources.title: Apprenticeship Wage Subsidy (AWS) - Apprenticeship and Trades Certification Division
sources.terms_note: The province owns the copyright and grants the public permission to use the information on its website; third-party graphics, audio and video may not be reproduced.

funding_types.quote: The AWS program provides a wage subsidy of 75%, to a maximum of $14.00 an hour, for all apprentices funded under the program.

cost_share.text: 75% of the apprentice's wages, up to $14.00 an hour
cost_share.quote: The AWS program provides a wage subsidy of 75%, to a maximum of $14.00 an hour, for all apprentices funded under the program.

criteria.text: An incorporated business or a sole proprietorship, registered to do business in Newfoundland and Labrador
criteria.quote: must be incorporated businesses or sole proprietorships, and registered to conduct business in Newfoundland and Labrador;

criteria.text: The employer has an office or operation in the province
criteria.quote: must have an office or operation in the province;

criteria.text: The money helps pay an apprentice you hire
criteria.quote: The AWS is paid directly to employers who are approved to hire the apprentice

criteria.text: A certified journeyperson in the trade is on site (you sign a memorandum of understanding confirming it)
criteria.quote: must be eligible to sign a memorandum of understanding with the Apprenticeship and Trades Certification Division, that confirms they have a certified journeyperson on site in the appropriate trade;

criteria.text: In good standing with the Registry of Companies and Deeds
criteria.quote: must be in good standing with the Newfoundland and Labrador Registry of Companies and Deeds;

criteria.text: You offer the apprentice the work experience the trade requires
criteria.quote: must offer relevant work experience to the apprentice as required by the Apprenticeship and Trades Certification Division;

criteria.text: The apprentice is registered (or can register) and has done a pre-employment course in an eligible trade
criteria.quote: Apprentices must be eligible to register or already registered with the Apprenticeship and Trades Certification Division and have completed a pre-employment course in an eligible trade.

contacts.label: Department of Education and Early Childhood Development
contacts.quote: Contact Education and Early Childhood Development P.O. Box 8700 St. John’s, NL A1B 4J6 Tel: 1.709.729.5097 education@gov.nl.ca

research.notes: The program sits with the Apprenticeship and Trades Certification Division (Education and Early Childhood Development), not JGRD. Structure: 'incorporated businesses or sole proprietorships' gives corporation and sole_proprietor; a co-operative or non-profit may or may not count as an incorporated business, so both are unclear; partnerships and not-registered businesses miss. Hourly cap only, so no max_amount; cost_share is the 75% rate. Intake: not stated. Contact: the page says 'contact an Apprenticeship Program Officer' but gives no number; the only phone and email on the page are the department's general line in the footer, labelled as such. The staff listing page and the program guidelines were not fetched.
